lessonTitleEnglish: Multiplying a vector by a number — Practice
unit: Геометрия · Глава II. Векторы в пространстве
source: По темам армянских учебников математики для 11 класса (базовый уровень)

stages.headline: Точка M лежит на AB, AM : MB = 1 : 2. Вырази AM через AB.
stages.headlineEnglish: M on AB with AM : MB = 1 : 2. Express AM through AB.
stages.problemText: M on AB with AM : MB = 1 : 2. Express AM through AB.

stages.headline: |a| = 2. Найди k, если |ka| = 6, и ka противоположно направлен a.
stages.headlineEnglish: |a| = 2. Find k if |ka| = 6 and ka is opposite to a.
stages.problemText: |a| = 2. Find k if |ka| = 6 and ka is opposite to a.

stages.headline: BM — медиана треугольника ABC. Вырази BM через BA и BC.
stages.headlineEnglish: BM is a median of triangle ABC. Express BM through BA and BC.
stages.problemText: BM is a median of triangle ABC. Express BM through BA and BC.
stages.solutionSteps: 1. M — середина AC ⇒ BM = ½(BA + BC).
